clips.title: The story
paras: Following a rockslide, an unusually large elemental named Avala emerged and began triggering erratic weather swings and secondary landslides. An observer tasks adventurers with hunting down the elemental and claiming its core to secure the area. Defeating the creature restores stability to the mountain slopes and safeguards travelers from deadly winter perils.

The disturbances began when a sudden rockslide destabilized the mountain pass, opening the way for elemental activity. Among the creatures that surfaced, one particular elemental stood out, towering over its kin in sheer size and raw power. Given the informal moniker "Avala" by the watchful questgiver, this potent entity is not merely an imposing presence—it directly fuels localized atmospheric turmoil and destabilizes the surrounding cliffs. Its presence poses an immediate peril to anyone attempting to navigate the area, as unstable earth and sudden winter chills make ordinary travel lethal.

Recognizing the escalating danger of Avala's influence over the terrain, a call was put forth to eliminate the beast before further collapses claimed lives. Slaying the creature requires facing both its elemental ferocity and the harsh conditions it generates, culminating in the recovery of its core as definitive proof of its demise. With Avala vanquished and its animating heart secured, the violent weather shifts subside, restoring a measure of safety to the surrounding mountain passes and safeguarding future travelers from needless catastrophe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasional weather changes and other minor slides.
I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Light bless you, adventurer. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.
